remarks: Privately Tucked Away from the Road Along the Greenwich border and Adjacent to the 550 Acre Stamford Land Conservation Trust is a Peaceful Hideaway that awaits you. This Secluded Ranch Features a Circular Driveway, an Abundance of Natural Sunlight, a Generously Sized Rear Deck, Hardwood Floors, Slate Patio With Hot Tub & A/G Salt Water Pool, two Propane Fireplaces Coupled with Wooded Views Throughout Perfect for Family Entertaining. The Updated Eat In Kitchen has a Large Center Island and Kitchen Sink With Unobstructed Views of the Extensive Rear Yard. The Primary Bedroom Faces Away from the Road that Contains a Full Private Bath. The Meticulously Finished Lower Level Includes a Half Bath, Laundry Facility, Two Car Garage Access and Sliders Leading to the Yard with Patio inviting an In Law Possibility, Complete with Murphy Bed. Bring Your Belongings and Move In, Nothing to do! Just down the road from the Red Barn Stables horse farm for you horse lovers! Less than Five Minutes to Exit 33 on the Merritt Parkway. Make Your Move!
